item.title: Almost two acres in Hertford, North Carolina. Circa 1910. $165,000
item.description: Fixer upper alert in Hertford, North Carolina! This has potential! The house was built in 1910. It is located on 1.82 acres in Hertford, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, baseboards, nice staircase, built-in bookshelves and an enclosed back porch. There are a couple of outbuildings on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,300 square feet. $165,000 Contact Jonathan Moore with Water Street Real Estate Group: 252-339-5250 From the Zillow listing: Com

item.title: Nice acreage! Circa 1896. On 19 acres in Virginia. $340,000
item.description: This house has some nice acreage! Pretty area! The house was built in 1896. It is located on 19.53 acres in Lexington, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, baseboards, bay windows and crown moulding. The house definitely needs work, but it sure is a pretty setting! There are multiple outbuildings on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,245 square feet. $340,000 Contact Kara F. Braddick with Real Broker: 540-460-0484 From the Zillow listing: Ready to homes

item.title: A lot of house for the money! Almost 4,000 sf. Over an acre in Pennsylvania. $229,900
item.description: This looks like a lot of house for the money! Almost 4,000 square feet of living space! The house was built in 1922. It is located on 1.23 acres in New Castle, Pennsylvania. The house features a sunroom, updated kitchen, wood floors, crown moulding, pretty fireplaces, wainscoting, built-ins, arched windows, baseboards, rich paneling and a finished third floor. The property has a big backyard with a nice patio. Six bedrooms, five bathrooms and 3,854 square feet. $229,900 Contact Marco Sibeto with

item.title: Some pretty details inside! Circa 1925 in South Carolina. $159,900
item.description: This house has some nice details inside! Love the door casements. The house was built in 1925. It is located on .4 acre in Manning, South Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, some wood floors, bead board wainscoting, picture rails, pretty door casements and original mantels. The lot is shaded with mature trees. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,520 square feet. $159,900 Contact Brand Name Real Estate From the Zillow listing: If you have a love for old houses, this might be what

item.title: Beautiful details! The Nucholls-Murray House, C. 1923 in Tennessee. $462,000
item.description: This house has really beautiful features inside! It is known as the Nucholls-Murray House. It was built in 1923. The house is located on .52 acre in Jackson, Tennessee. The house features a large front patio, a covered side porch, beautiful ceiling medallions, wood floors, pretty staircase, gorgeous sunroom with arched windows, wainscoting, crown moulding, french doors and a pretty kichen. There is a detached garage on the property. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,696 square feet. $462,000

item.title: Such tall ceilings! Horne and India Kilpatrick House. Circa 1908 in Texas. $110,000
item.description: Such tall ceilings in this house! That’s a big foyer too! This house is known as the Horne and India Kilpatrick House. It was built in 1908. It is located on .36 acre in Reagan, Texas. The house features a covered front porch, a screened in porch, tall ceilings, wood floors, crown moulding, wide baseboards, wainscoting, bay windows, vintage light fixtures and fretwork. The house looks livable. I would move in and work room by room. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,275 square feet. $110,000 Co

item.title: The historic Crookston House. Circa 1894 in Utah. $375,000
item.description: This is a sweet house! Bet that carpeting has been protecting some pretty hardwood floors. Known as the Crookston House. It was built in 1894. The house is located on .7 acre in Logan, Utah. The house features a small covered porch, a back deck, vintage kitchen, crown moulding, wainscoting, picture rails, transom windows and a claw foot tub. There is a detached building on the property. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,827 square feet. $375,000 Contact Robert Matasic with PPC Residential Divis

item.title: So cute! Vintage kitchen! “The Yellow Sweetie”. Over an acre in Vermont. $325,000
item.description: Love this house! The kitchen is perfect! The house was built in 1940. It is located on 1.23 acres in South Londonberry, Vermont. The house features wainscoting, soaking tub, vintage kitchen sink, vintage stove, wood floors, brick fireplace, baseboards, screened in porch and indoor shutters. There is a detached garage on the property. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 976 square feet. $325,000 Contact Carrie Mathews with Winhall Real Estate: 802-297-1550 From the Zillow listing: “The Yellow Sweetie

item.title: Unique floors! Pretty porch! Circa 1905 in Washington. $335,000
item.description: This house has unique wood floors! I love the porch and the staircase! The house was built in 1905. It is located in Asotin, Washington. The house features a pretty wrap around front porch, unique wood floors, stained glass transom windows, picture rails, nice staircase, unpainted woodwork, wide baseboards, vintage light fixtures and solid wood doors. If you pull up street view you can see the house has pretty scenery. Four bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,842 square feet. $335,000 Contact Witney Br

item.title: 19 acres! Stone cottage in West Virginia. $193,000
item.description: This stone cottage has a lot of potential! Nice acreage with it! The cottage was built in 1945. It is located on 19 acres in Alum Creek, West Virginia. The house features a stone exterior, wood floors, stone fireplace and baseboards. The house needs some updating and some undoing of past renovations. I would have taken pictures with blinds open. But the price seems reasonable with the acreage. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,725 square feet. $193,000 Contact Christa Vance with Old Colony: 304
